findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_knowledge_full" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_knowledge, search_by_error, get_reviews · Private data: get_knowledge_full, list_datasets, dataset_info, read_dataset · Public sink: search_knowledge, search_by_error.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_knowledge, search_by_error, get_reviews · Private data: get_knowledge_full, list_datasets, dataset_info, read_dataset · Public sink: search_knowledge, search_by_error

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
